description: The modern MiG-29SMT, a separate jet from the MiG-29 Fulcrum mod (both can be installed together). An all-glass cockpit with three large colour displays (flight display, tactical display with stores, radar warning with your own heat and radar signature, engines and systems) and an up-front control panel whose keys light up with flight events; a strike role with Kh-29L and KAB-500L laser-guided weapons and the Kh-31P anti-radiation missile, plus R-77, R-73 and R-27 missiles and the GSh-30-1 cannon; stock-style damage; SMT liveries; and rear-view mirrors that really reflect with the NO Mirrors plugin.
